description: Create the quant module directory structure
steps: Create src/prediction_data/quant/ directory
Create __init__.py with module exports
Create models.py for Pydantic data models
Create data/ subdirectory for data fetching
Create preprocessing/ subdirectory for transformations
Create metrics/ subdirectory for metric computations

description: Create ClickHouse tables for quant data storage
steps: Create pm_market_meta table with condition_id, gamma_market_id, slug, question, outcomes, asset_ids, end_ts, status
Create pm_trades_raw table with trade_id, condition_id, asset_id, side, price, size, match_ts
Create pm_book_snapshots table (optional) with condition_id, asset_id, snapshot_ts, best_bid, best_ask, spread, mid
Create pm_quant_metrics table for storing computed metrics per window
Add table creation to gold init-tables CLI command
Verify tables created with correct engines (ReplacingMergeTree)

description: Implement market metadata fetching from Gamma API
steps: Create data/market_meta.py module
Implement fetch_market_meta(condition_id | gamma_id | slug) function
Parse Gamma API response: conditionId, outcomes, outcomePrices, clob_token_ids
Extract end_ts from endTime/resolveTime fields
Create MarketMeta Pydantic model with all required fields
Handle active/closed/resolved status parsing
Store fetched metadata to pm_market_meta table
Add caching to avoid redundant fetches

description: Implement trade history fetching from CLOB API
steps: Create data/trades.py module
Implement fetch_trades(condition_id, after_ts, before_ts, asset_id) function
Handle pagination using before/after cursors
Parse trade fields: trade_id, market, asset_id, side, price, size, match_time
Create Trade Pydantic model for trade records
Normalize timestamps to UTC with millisecond precision
Parse price/size strings to Decimal for precision
Validate price is in (0, 1) range
Store trades to pm_trades_raw table
Implement incremental fetching (only new trades)
Create preprocessing/normalization.py module
Implement parse_timestamp(match_time) -> datetime with UTC
Implement parse_decimal(price_str) -> Decimal with validation
Handle price normalization if in cents/bps (convert to probability)
Handle multi-part trade aggregation using bucket_index/market_order_id
Add validation for required fields
Log and skip invalid trades with warning

description: Create Pydantic models for quant data
steps: Create MarketMeta model with condition_id, outcomes, asset_ids, end_ts, status
Create Trade model with trade_id, condition_id, asset_id, side, price, size, match_ts
Create BookSnapshot model with condition_id, asset_id, snapshot_ts, best_bid, best_ask
Create PricePoint model with timestamp, price, volume, source (trade/mid)
Create QuantMetrics model for computed metrics output
Add model validators for price bounds, timestamp ordering

description: Add CLI commands for data fetching
steps: Create quant CLI group in prediction-data CLI
Add 'quant fetch-meta --condition-id <id>' command
Add 'quant backfill-trades --condition-id <id> --start-date --end-date' command
Add 'quant list-markets' command to show stored markets
Add --dry-run flag for preview without storage
Add progress output for long-running fetches
